post.description:
Another newsroom vouches for the entry (it checked with the issuer). The registering newsroom
cannot confirm its own entry; confirming twice changes nothing.

« Faux repéré »: a circulating copy that imitates this original, kept with its word diff so
the next newsroom (and the Fil officiel) sees at once what was changed.

The issuer signs its original: Ed25519 over issuer, number, date, title and the text's
fingerprint. Sealing an entry already sealed with a valid key returns the same seal.

get.description: The seal and its QR again (to print or download it later).

Everything a phone needs to check the seal itself: the signed fields, the exact message,
the signature and the issuer's public key. Only public newsrooms' seals are served.

post.description: The server-side check, for browsers without Ed25519 in WebCrypto.

get.description: The issuers' public keys (to check seals offline) and the revoked ones.

« Fil officiel »: what the institutions really published and the fakes caught imitating it,
newest first. Only newsrooms that publish (`is_public`) appear; a fake whose original is not
public is left out (its diff would show the original's words).

post.description: Compare a circulating text with the registered originals (no model involved).

cites no fact or brings a number of its own is dropped. Drawn dashed: a suggestion.
A journalist keeps a suggested angle on a dossier (`item.data.angles`).

communiqué, rapport…) and the files of the Registre's originals, newest first.

« Publier la version signée »: publishes what was signed, as long as nothing changed since
(same digest).

Each dossier is signed with its own verdict, or the suggested one, and its explanation, or
the analysis reason. One that cannot be signed is skipped with the reason, never guessed.

get.description: How « Reprendre ce verdict » would read a fact-checker's rating, shown before signing.

post.description:
The review is relayed as the fact-checker's, with its date and link: it becomes the
dossier's source [1] and the newsroom signs the matching verdict under its own byline.

get.description:
Everything done on the dossier, dated: checks, sources, questions and answers, routes,
signatures. Printed as « Exporter le carnet ».

« Attestation de vérification »: the carnet's summary signed with the server's key, so a
partner, a court or a reader can check that this newsroom did this work on this version.
« Exporter le carnet »: the carnet as an A4 PDF, `carnet-FAN-0142.pdf`.
The attestation on one A4 page, its signed text attached inside the PDF.

post.description: Anyone can check an attestation against the server's key (no account).

get.description:
« Où la correction est passée »: the truth side only (no proof, no notes) and the counts.
Same visibility as `/public/verdicts/{id}`: a public newsroom's published claim with a
confirmed verdict, nothing else.
Every format of the signed verdict (see `render`), the poster, the seal and the reread.
The QR of the card and the story: the newsroom's signature over the published verdict.

The seal of a published verdict as it reads now, to compare with a card's QR. Only a public
newsroom's published verdict; nothing of the dossier beyond what its public page shows.

post.description:
The server-side check, for browsers without Ed25519 in WebCrypto: the QR's message and
signature against the key it names, and whether that version is still the published one.

« Relu en malgache »: the journalist read the Malagasy formats (lines, SMS, post, card) and
vouches for these exact strings (`mg_hash`). Until then they cannot be copied or sent, and any
change to them afterwards locks them again.

The journalist sent the formats down these routes (from their own phone, radio or print
shop): each becomes a truth stop `sent`. Malagasy formats go only as a speaker reread them:
rendered again here, they must match the attested strings exactly, or they stay locked.

A partner radio marks a flash « Diffusé » from its token link (no account): the truth
stop for that station becomes `broadcast`.
